events.title: Corona Capital, Mexico City
events.note: Three days of rock, pop and electronic music at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, in its 16th edition. Gorillaz, Twenty One Pilots and The Strokes headline, with The xx, Underworld, James Blake, Tricky, Peaches and Santigold.
